description: How much concrete solid steps need, from the total height to climb: number of risers, riser height, treads, top landing, cubic yards and 80 lb bags. Formula: Risers n = ⌈total rise ÷ max riser⌉; riser height R = total rise ÷ n. Side profile area = tread × R × n(n − 1) ÷ 2 + landing depth × n × R (each lower tread is a block of its own height; the landing sits at full height). Volume (cu ft) = profile (sq in) × width (in) ÷ 1,728; cubic yards = cu ft × (1 + waste) ÷ 27; bags = cu ft × (1 + waste) ÷ bag yield.

bag_yield_cf.description: Bag yield (from the bag) (cu ft/bag); default 0.6

landing_depth_in.description: Top landing depth (0 = no landing) (in); default 36

max_riser_in.description: Max riser height (IRC 7¾ in; check your local code) (in); default 7.75

total_rise_in.description: Total rise (ground to top of landing) (in); default 21
